bedray.opt.renderer.desc: Hardware uses the saved RT mode. Voxel uses the included experimental software renderer with textured block models, world lighting and traced shadows. Only loaded sections can become resident; actual coverage is shown at runtime. Unsupported surfaces retain raster. Physical light transport and temporal guides remain incomplete.
bedray.opt.renderer.req: Included Compute provider and Minecraft Vulkan backend; no RT extensions required for Voxel.
bedray.opt.renderer_status.desc: Reports the requested renderer and host command recording. A recorded frame does not establish gameplay compatibility.
bedray.opt.renderer_status.req: Missing add-ons and initialization failures are shown explicitly.
bedray.renderer.status.missing: Unavailable: the included Compute provider is missing or incompatible
bedray.opt.compute_scene.desc: Session scene for the selected voxel renderer. Synthetic replaces the world with a fixed diagnostic scene; live mode uses actual loaded block models and world lighting. World Renderer remains the main switch. A saved voxel choice starts in live mode on the next launch.
bedray.opt.compute_debug_view.desc: Inspect textured world shading, geometric normals, ray distance or unsupported and missing cells. Debug views isolate the bounded compute scene; full physical light transport is still in development.
bedray.opt.compute_debug_view.req: Requires a Bedray Compute provider with debug-view support.
bedray.compute.data.desc: Loaded-world streaming with bounded CPU capture, uploads and GPU residency. Resident coverage may be smaller than the requested distance.
bedray.compute.failure: Voxel renderer stopped: %s. See Renderer Status or the log.
bedray.fg.voxel_unavailable: Disabled for voxel diagnostics: matching depth and motion guides are not implemented.
bedray.page.title: Vulkan
bedray.option.quality_preset.tooltip: 3D resolution presets for the Bilinear upscaler. The world is rendered at the reduced size and stretched to the window with a bilinear blit (no reconstruction). The GUI stays at 100%.
bedray.option.custom_scale.tooltip: 3D render resolution from 25% to 100% with 5% step. Active only when Custom preset is selected.
bedray.upscaler.tooltip.bilinear.availab: Built-in bilinear stretch of the scaled 3D target. No temporal reconstruction.
bedray.upscaler.tooltip.xess.available: Temporal super resolution (XeSS). Applied immediately: the Vulkan device was created with the XeSS extensions at startup.
bedray.upscaler.tooltip.xess.restart_req: Temporal super resolution (XeSS). The Vulkan device was created without the XeSS extensions (library appeared after startup, or -Dvkrtx.upscaler.preregister=false): applied after a game restart.
bedray.upscaler.tooltip.xess.library_mis: libxess.dll is not found in bedray/natives. Selecting it has no effect: Bilinear stays active.
bedray.upscaler.tooltip.dlss.available: Temporal super resolution (NVIDIA DLSS). Applied immediately: the Vulkan device was created with the DLSS extensions at startup.
bedray.upscaler.tooltip.dlss.restart_req: Temporal super resolution (NVIDIA DLSS). The Vulkan device was created without the DLSS extensions (library appeared after startup, or -Dvkrtx.upscaler.preregister=false): applied after a game restart.
bedray.upscaler.tooltip.dlss.library_mis: nvngx_dlss.dll and vkb_dlss.dll are not both installed (see docs/INSTALL.md). Selecting it has no effect: Bilinear stays active.
bedray.upscaler.tooltip.dlss.unsupported: DLSS needs an NVIDIA RTX GPU with a current driver. Selecting it has no effect: Bilinear stays active.
bedray.upscaler.tooltip.dlss.not_impleme: Not implemented yet. Selecting it has no effect: Bilinear stays active.
bedray.option.xess_mode.tooltip: XeSS render scale: the world is rendered smaller by the ratio of the mode and reconstructed to the window size by XeSS. Applied immediately: the XeSS context is re-created on the next frame. Ratios from the XeSS SDK 3.0.2 developer guide; the exact input size is returned by the XeSS library.
bedray.option.xess_mode.tooltip.restart: XeSS render scale: the world is rendered smaller by the ratio of the mode and reconstructed to the window size by XeSS. The Vulkan device was created without the XeSS requirements, so the mode takes effect after a game restart. Ratios from the XeSS SDK 3.0.2 developer guide; the exact input size is returned by the XeSS library.
bedray.option.dlss_mode.tooltip: DLSS Super Resolution: the world is rendered at the size NVIDIA DLSS asks for this mode and reconstructed to the window size. DLAA renders at full size. Applied immediately: the DLSS feature is re-created on the next frame.
bedray.option.dlss_mode.tooltip.restart: DLSS Super Resolution: the world is rendered at the size NVIDIA DLSS asks for this mode and reconstructed to the window size. DLAA renders at full size. The Vulkan device was created without the DLSS requirements, so the mode takes effect after a game restart.
bedray.upscaler.tooltip.fsr.available: Temporal super resolution (AMD FSR 3.1/2, official FidelityFX Vulkan library). Applied immediately. Frame Generation is not available.
bedray.upscaler.tooltip.fsr.restart_requ: Temporal super resolution (AMD FSR 3.1/2, official FidelityFX Vulkan library). The Vulkan device was created without the FSR features (library appeared after startup, or -Dvkrtx.upscaler.preregister=false): applied after a game restart.
bedray.upscaler.tooltip.fsr.library_miss: The official AMD amd_fidelityfx_vk.dll (FidelityFX SDK v1.1.4, PrebuiltSignedDLL) is not installed (see docs/INSTALL.md), or the file is not an official build. Selecting it has no effect: Bilinear stays active.
bedray.option.fsr_mode.tooltip: AMD FSR: the world is rendered at the size the FidelityFX library returns for this mode (Native AA 1.0x, Quality 1.5x, Balanced 1.7x, Performance 2.0x, Ultra Performance 3.0x) and reconstructed to the window size. Applied immediately: the FSR context is re-created on the next frame.
bedray.option.fsr_mode.tooltip.restart: AMD FSR: the world is rendered at the size the FidelityFX library returns for this mode (Native AA 1.0x, Quality 1.5x, Balanced 1.7x, Performance 2.0x, Ultra Performance 3.0x) and reconstructed to the window size. The Vulkan device was created without the FSR requirements, so the mode takes effect after a game restart.
bedray.option.fsr_version.tooltip: Which FSR upscaler inside the AMD FidelityFX Vulkan library is used. Auto: the newest one (FSR 3.1). Only versions present in the installed official library are listed. FSR 4 is not available on Vulkan.
bedray.option.fsr_sharpness.tooltip: Robust Contrast Adaptive Sharpening after the FSR upscale. 0% turns the pass off. Applied on the next frame.
On: feed flat voxel cube face normals to DLSS Ray Reconstruction, preserving sharp block edges. Off: feed perturbed shading normals, smoothing voxel corners.
bedray.option.auto_texture_lod_bias.tool: Automatically applies negative Mipmap LOD bias based on resolution scale (log2(scale)) to prevent blurry textures under DLSS, FSR and XeSS.
bedray.option.texture_lod_bias_offset.to: Additional Mipmap LOD bias offset. Negative values make textures sharper (-0.2 to -0.5 recommended for pixel-art textures).
bedray.option.point_sampling_sharpness.t: Uses point sampling when textures are magnified. Restart or reload resource packs to recreate existing Vulkan samplers.
bedray.option.enable_hardware_ray_tracin: Enables hardware-accelerated ray tracing using Vulkan Ray Queries (VK_KHR_ray_query). Requires compatible GPU hardware.
bedray.option.rt_mode.tooltip: Selects the ray tracing simulation mode.
bedray.rt_mode.rays.tooltip: Ray Tracing: the world is drawn by rays through loaded chunks with traced shadows, glowing blocks, reflections and ambient occlusion. Entities and particles stay raster.
bedray.rt_mode.path.tooltip: Path Tracing: full light transport with bounces instead of separate effects. Slower, smoothed by denoiser / accumulation.
bedray.rt_mode.ao.tooltip: Traced ambient occlusion only: soft contact shadows and shading in corners.
bedray.rt_mode.direct.tooltip: Direct sun and moon light, hard or soft shadows, and light from emissive blocks.
bedray.option.path_bounces.tooltip: Maximum light bounces per path for Path Tracing.
bedray.option.path_spp.tooltip: Number of paths or rays traced per pixel and frame.
bedray.option.path_distance.tooltip: Maximum distance traversed by rays in blocks.
bedray.option.rays_shadows.tooltip: Traced direct lighting and shadows from the sun and moon.
bedray.option.rays_emissive.tooltip: Traced light and shadows from glowing blocks (torches, lanterns, glowstone, lava).
bedray.option.rt_fog.tooltip: Enables ray-traced atmospheric depth and volumetric distance fog.
bedray.option.rt_fog_in_scattering.toolt: Sunlight and skylight in-scattering through the fog.
bedray.option.dlss_rr_enabled.tooltip: NVIDIA DLSS 3.5 Ray Reconstruction: AI neural denoiser replacing hand-tuned filters, enhancing stability and lighting detail. Requires NVIDIA RTX GPU.
bedray.option.path_denoiser.tooltip: Denoiser used for ray-traced lighting. DLSS_RR: NVIDIA AI Ray Reconstruction; NRD: Real-time Denoiser; Off: temporal accumulation only.
bedray.option.auto_normals.tooltip: Generates relief and normal maps from block textures for packs without LabPBR normal maps.
bedray.option.auto_normal_strength.toolt: Depth and strength of generated normal map relief.
bedray.option.waving_foliage.tooltip: Classic shaderpack wind waving on grass, leaves and cutout foliage.
bedray.option.waving_foliage_strength.to: Strength of the waving foliage wind motion (0 to 200 percent).
bedray.option.path_auto_exposure.tooltip: Dynamically adapts scene exposure based on average light levels.
bedray.option.rt_preset.tooltip: Sets all ray tracing values at once (effects, rays per pixel, distances). Custom: the values of the advanced / expert settings. Changing one of them switches to Custom.
bedray.option.rt_debug_view.tooltip: Replaces the rendered world with a specific ray tracing debug buffer (normals, depth, albedo, reflections, etc.).
bedray.option.debug_overlay.tooltip: Toggles the in-game F3 debug overlay including Bedray real-time performance and geometry metrics.
bedray.option.reset_all_defaults.tooltip: Resets all Vulkan upscaling, ray tracing, and experimental settings to factory defaults.
bedray.preview.hint_split: mouse moves the split, click locks
bedray.settings.title: Bedray Settings
bedray.settings.locked: Needs another option, feature or runtime library to be active first. A Fast/Beautiful profile can hold that option as well.
bedray.settings.locked_by_profile: Set by the Fast/Beautiful quality profile. Switch the profile to Custom to tune it by hand.
bedray.settings.preset_staged: %s preset values staged. Apply to commit.
bedray.settings.voxel_unrelated: These settings belong to the hardware renderer. Choose another category.
bedray.settings.coverage: Runtime: %s/%s chunks; %s resident, %s queued; GPU %s/%s MiB%s
bedray.settings.inactive: This setting requires another renderer, mode or enabled feature.
bedray.settings.runtime_separate: Requested settings and runtime execution are separate. See the runtime line for current state.
bedray.opt.voxel_quality_profile.desc: Fast lowers the memory budget and skips diffuse bounce and layered transparency. Beautiful enables those effects. Both follow Minecraft distance; Custom unlocks the individual settings. The upscaler, frame generation and lighting stay editable in every profile. Apply commits the choice.
bedray.opt.path_quality_profile.desc: Fast: 1 sample, 2 bounces, 256-block path distance. Beautiful: 2 samples, 4 bounces, 512 blocks. Custom unlocks those three values. The upscaler, frame generation and lighting stay editable in every profile; the denoiser choice is never changed by a profile.
bedray.opt.voxel_distance_auto.desc: Request the game render distance. Only loaded sections are captured; residency can be limited by memory and streaming budgets.
bedray.opt.voxel_distance_chunks.desc: Requested horizontal radius when Follow Minecraft is off. Does not load or generate chunks.
bedray.opt.voxel_memory_budget_mib.desc: Maximum scene storage in MiB. Nearby sections have priority; memory pressure can reduce coverage.
bedray.opt.voxel_diffuse_bounce.desc: Enable the supported diffuse lighting bounce. Full physical light transport is still in development.
bedray.opt.voxel_translucent_optics.desc: Enable the layered transparent optical path. Off skips this extra traversal and retains raster where replacement is unsupported.
bedray.opt.ui_expert.desc: Show low-level rendering and diagnostics. Apply rebuilds this screen with the new options.
bedray.opt.frame_generation_provider.des: Changing provider requires a restart. Installed files do not establish that generation is active.
bedray.opt.upscaler_backend.desc: Renders the 3D world smaller and reconstructs the full image. DLSS, FSR and XeSS use temporal reconstruction; Built-in uses spatial scaling.
bedray.opt.quality_preset.desc: 3D resolution presets for the Bilinear upscaler. The world is rendered at the reduced size and stretched to the window with a bilinear blit (no reconstruction). The GUI stays at 100%.
bedray.opt.custom_scale.desc: 3D render resolution from 25% to 100% with 5% step. Active only when Custom preset is selected.
bedray.opt.xess_mode.desc: XeSS render scale: the world is rendered smaller by the ratio of the mode and reconstructed to the window size by XeSS. Applied immediately: the XeSS context is re-created on the next frame. Ratios from the XeSS SDK 3.0.2 developer guide; the exact input size is returned by the XeSS library.
bedray.opt.xess_mode.desc.restart: XeSS render scale: the world is rendered smaller by the ratio of the mode and reconstructed to the window size by XeSS. The Vulkan device was created without the XeSS requirements, so the mode takes effect after a game restart. Ratios from the XeSS SDK 3.0.2 developer guide; the exact input size is returned by the XeSS library.
bedray.opt.dlss_mode.desc: DLSS Super Resolution: the world is rendered at the size NVIDIA DLSS asks for this mode and reconstructed to the window size. DLAA renders at full size. Applied immediately: the DLSS feature is re-created on the next frame.
bedray.opt.dlss_mode.desc.restart: DLSS Super Resolution: the world is rendered at the size NVIDIA DLSS asks for this mode and reconstructed to the window size. DLAA renders at full size. The Vulkan device was created without the DLSS requirements, so the mode takes effect after a game restart.
bedray.opt.fsr_mode.desc: AMD FSR: the world is rendered at the size the FidelityFX library returns for this mode (Native AA 1.0x, Quality 1.5x, Balanced 1.7x, Performance 2.0x, Ultra Performance 3.0x) and reconstructed to the window size. Applied immediately: the FSR context is re-created on the next frame.
bedray.opt.fsr_mode.desc.restart: AMD FSR: the world is rendered at the size the FidelityFX library returns for this mode (Native AA 1.0x, Quality 1.5x, Balanced 1.7x, Performance 2.0x, Ultra Performance 3.0x) and reconstructed to the window size. The Vulkan device was created without the FSR requirements, so the mode takes effect after a game restart.
bedray.opt.fsr_version.desc: Which FSR upscaler inside the AMD FidelityFX Vulkan library is used. Auto: the newest one (FSR 3.1). Only versions present in the installed official library are listed. FSR 4 is not available on Vulkan.
bedray.opt.fsr_sharpness.desc: Robust Contrast Adaptive Sharpening after the FSR upscale. 0% turns the pass off. Applied on the next frame.
bedray.opt.dlss_rr_geometric_normals.des: On: feed flat voxel cube face normals to DLSS Ray Reconstruction, preserving sharp block edges. Off: feed perturbed shading normals, smoothing voxel corners.
bedray.opt.auto_texture_lod_bias.desc: Automatically applies negative Mipmap LOD bias based on resolution scale (log2(scale)) to prevent blurry textures under DLSS, FSR and XeSS.
bedray.opt.texture_lod_bias_offset.desc: Additional Mipmap LOD bias offset. Negative values make textures sharper (-0.2 to -0.5 recommended for pixel-art textures).
bedray.opt.point_sampling_sharpness.desc: Uses point sampling when textures are magnified. Restart or reload resource packs to recreate existing Vulkan samplers.
bedray.opt.enable_hardware_ray_tracing.d: Enables hardware-accelerated ray tracing using Vulkan Ray Queries (VK_KHR_ray_query). Requires compatible GPU hardware.
bedray.opt.rt_mode.desc: Selects the ray tracing simulation mode.
bedray.opt.path_bounces.desc: Maximum light bounces per path for Path Tracing.
bedray.opt.path_spp.desc: Number of paths or rays traced per pixel and frame.
bedray.opt.path_distance.desc: Maximum distance traversed by rays in blocks.
bedray.opt.rays_shadows.desc: Traced direct lighting and shadows from the sun and moon.
bedray.opt.rays_emissive.desc: Traced light and shadows from glowing blocks (torches, lanterns, glowstone, lava).
bedray.opt.rt_fog.desc: Enables ray-traced atmospheric depth and volumetric distance fog.
bedray.opt.rt_fog_in_scattering.desc: Sunlight and skylight in-scattering through the fog.
bedray.opt.dlss_rr_enabled.desc: NVIDIA DLSS 3.5 Ray Reconstruction: AI neural denoiser replacing hand-tuned filters, enhancing stability and lighting detail. Requires NVIDIA RTX GPU.
bedray.opt.path_denoiser.desc: Denoiser used for ray-traced lighting. DLSS_RR: NVIDIA AI Ray Reconstruction; NRD: Real-time Denoiser; Off: temporal accumulation only.
bedray.opt.auto_normals.desc: Generates relief and normal maps from block textures for packs without LabPBR normal maps.
bedray.opt.auto_normal_strength.desc: Depth and strength of generated normal map relief.
bedray.opt.waving_foliage.desc: Classic shaderpack wind waving on grass, leaves and cutout foliage.
bedray.opt.waving_foliage_strength.desc: Strength of the waving foliage wind motion (0 to 200 percent).
bedray.opt.path_auto_exposure.desc: Dynamically adapts scene exposure based on average light levels.
bedray.opt.rt_preset.desc: Sets all ray tracing values at once (effects, rays per pixel, distances). Custom: the values of the advanced / expert settings. Changing one of them switches to Custom.
bedray.opt.rt_debug_view.desc: Replaces the rendered world with a specific ray tracing debug buffer (normals, depth, albedo, reflections, etc.).
bedray.opt.debug_overlay.desc: Toggles the in-game F3 debug overlay including Bedray real-time performance and geometry metrics.
bedray.opt.reset_all_defaults.desc: Resets all Vulkan upscaling, ray tracing, and experimental settings to factory defaults.
bedray.opt.water_style.desc: Vanilla keeps the classic clear animated water. Realistic adds waves, refraction and reflections.
bedray.opt.atm_godrays.desc: Visible beams of sun and moon light through leaves, windows and cave openings; strongest at sunrise and sunset.
bedray.opt.pt_preset.desc: Fast and Quality set rays per pixel, bounces and distance in one step. Custom appears when you change one of those values.
bedray.opt.path_caustics.desc: Sunlight focused by the water surface into moving bright patterns on the ground under water.
bedray.opt.path_exposure_ev.desc: Manual brightness offset in EV (-4.0 to +4.0). Shifts Auto Exposure when it is on, or sets the fixed brightness when Auto Exposure is off.
bedray.opt.rt_particles.desc: Smoke, flames, sparks, bubbles, block-break and weather splash particles in the ray traced image, occluded by terrain and lit by the scene.
bedray.opt.rt_weather.desc: Rain and snow columns in the ray traced image: occluded by terrain and fogged exactly as the game draws them, and never seen by the denoisers, so they do not smear or trail.
bedray.opt.rt_weather.req: Needs ray tracing and Particles in RT on.
bedray.opt.atm_bloom.desc: A soft glow around very bright lights and glowing blocks, like a camera lens.
bedray.opt.atm_sunglare.desc: A bright halo around the sun when you look at it; hidden behind blocks and clouds.
bedray.opt.atm_fog_aerial.desc: Far terrain fades into the colour of the sky, denser in rain and valleys. 0 turns it off.
bedray.opt.frame_generation_reflex.desc: Lowers input delay. Boost also raises GPU clocks.
bedray.opt.frame_generation_limit.desc: Caps the displayed frame rate (0 = no cap). Keeps frame pacing steady near the monitor refresh rate.
bedray.opt.frame_generation_status.desc: Read-only: whether frame generation is active, and why not when it is not.
bedray.opt.rt_distance_auto.desc: On: ray tracing covers the game render distance. Off: the manual distance.
bedray.opt.rt_distance_chunks.desc: Chunks covered by ray tracing when 'As in Game' is off.
bedray.opt.rt_vram_budget_mb.desc: GPU memory for chunk geometry; the farthest chunks are left out when it is full.
bedray.opt.rt_light_budget.desc: Most important glowing block faces that cast traced light.
bedray.opt.sun_size_tenths.desc: Disk diameter in tenths of a degree (real sun about 5). Bigger means softer shadows.
bedray.opt.atm_godrays_range.desc: Distance in blocks the beams are computed over.
bedray.opt.atm_bloom_threshold.desc: Brightness from which a pixel starts to glow.
bedray.opt.atm_bloom_scatter.desc: Balance between a tight and a wide glow.
bedray.opt.atm_fog_vanilla.desc: How much of the game's own fog is used.
bedray.settings.experience.vanilla.desc: Minecraft rendering with Bedray world tracing off. Suitable when tracing is not wanted or the GPU lacks the required extensions. Upscaling remains a separate setting.
bedray.settings.experience.path.desc: Full traced lighting, shadows, reflections and bounced light. Requires a compatible Vulkan hardware-RT GPU; suited to discrete RT GPUs with memory headroom. High rendering workload. Denoiser runtimes have separate requirements.
bedray.settings.experience.rays.desc: Configurable hardware ray-traced effects; experimental. Requires a compatible Vulkan RT GPU and an existing explicit experimental-mode opt-in. Disabled without that opt-in. Workload depends on enabled effects.
bedray.settings.experience.voxel.desc: Included experimental compute renderer for supported Vulkan GPUs, without RT extensions. Preserves raster where scene data is unavailable or unsupported. Memory and capture budgets limit actual coverage. Fast quality skips diffuse bounce and layered transparency; full physical path tracing is incomplete.
bedray.settings.experience.combinations: Compute and hardware world tracing are mutually exclusive. Separate pure-Voxel, RT + Vanilla and RT + Voxel compositors are not implemented and are not offered as selectable modes.
bedray.opt.rays_direct_translucent_shado: Glass, ice and water tint direct-light shadows. Off passes their light without the color filter; opaque blockers and foliage still cast shadows.
bedray.opt.rays_indirect_translucent_sha: Filter shadows inside reflections and bounced lighting through transparent materials. Camera transparency stays enabled.
bedray.opt.rays_cull_shared_glass.desc: Conservatively remove matching internal full-block glass faces after Sodium capture. Reload the world to rebuild all sections after changing this option.
bedray.opt.rays_transparency_stats.desc: Show delayed GPU query, candidate, layer and overflow counts in F3. Atomic counters add GPU overhead; off by default. Counts are not timings.
bedray.opt.rays_optical_materials.desc: Use authored IOR, thickness and absorption profiles, including dielectric clear-glass centres. Off restores legacy shader optics for comparison; clear interfaces can increase ray work.
bedray.opt.path_restir_di.desc: Reuses each pixel's glowing-block sample over frames instead of drawing a new one every frame, so torch light settles while the camera moves. Off re-samples every light per frame: noisier, and never carries an old record over.
bedray.opt.rays_restir_temporal.desc: A pixel keeps the block-light sample it chose last frame and refines it. Off re-samples block light every frame: noisier, and no old record is carried over.
bedray.opt.rays_restir_spatial.desc: A pixel also borrows samples from neighbours on the same surface (same normal, same plane), so one torch lights a wall from fewer, better-chosen samples. Needs ReSTIR Temporal Block Light on.
bedray.opt.path_restir_spatial.desc: A pixel also borrows light samples from neighbours on the same surface (same normal, same plane), so one torch lights a wall from fewer, better-chosen samples. Needs ReSTIR Direct Light on.
bedray.opt.path_restir_pt.desc: Reuses the light a pixel's first diffuse bounce brought back over the next frames, so bounced light settles while the camera moves. Costs about 0.6 GB of video memory at 1080p and one extra ray per reused pixel. Needs ReSTIR Direct Light on; the native backend ignores it.
